Playwright found 0 elements matching [data-testid^='tenant-code-'] inside /saas-admin/tenant-debts (Subscribers shows 8, Agents shows 2 correctly).

issues: Sidebar is collapsed to icon-only by default; group section titles (NT Commerce, إدارة SaaS, كتالوج المنصّة, التقارير والتدقيق, النظام) were not extractable via innerText in the collapsed state. Visually icons render and routing works — confirm Layout.js intentionally hides section headers when sidebar is collapsed or expose them as tooltips for discoverability.

Use <EntityCode uuid={row.tenant_id} type='tenant' testId={`tenant-code-${row.tenant_id}`} /> mirroring the Subscribers table implementation at SaasAdminPage.js line ~1075.
LOW: Carry-over from iter 12 — fix tz-naive date filter crash in audit_timeline_routes._ts_dt (still open, not in this iter's changeset).
LOW: Consider showing the 5 sidebar group section titles even when sidebar is collapsed (tooltip or hover) so super-admin can discover groupings.
critical_code_review_comments: MonitoringDashboard.js:178-188 — `data-testid={`quick-link-${to.replace('/saas-admin/', '')}`}` good. But QUICK_LINKS at lines 15-31 hard-codes 15 routes whose ordering & set is duplicated with Layout.js superAdminNavSections — risk of drift. Recommend extracting a single source-of-truth array (e.g. /lib/saasNav.js) consumed by both Layout.js and MonitoringDashboard.js so renaming/reordering happens in one place.

ServiceStatusMap.js:65-70 — Uses dynamic Tailwind classes `bg-${meta.color}-100 dark:bg-${meta.color}-900/30 text-${meta.color}-600 dark:text-${meta.color}-400`. Tailwind JIT may purge these in production builds. Either add to tailwind.config.js safelist (emerald-100/600, red-100/600, slate-100/600 + dark variants) or replace with a static map per status. Same pattern flagged in iter 12 for SaasAdminPage:2078.

ServiceStatusMap.js:31 — Polls /api/saas/platform-stats every 30s in parallel with MonitoringDashboard polling /api/saas/stats every 30s → 2 separate intervals, separate cache. Acceptable today but consider a single shared platformStats context + React-Query for backoff / dedupe.

platform_stats_routes.py:78-100 — redis import is inside the if-branch (good lazy-import). Redis ping uses 1.0s socket_timeout — at higher load this 1-second blocking call on every dashboard load could surprise. Consider caching the redis status for 10-30 seconds.

SaasAdminPage.js still hovering ~3011 lines from iter 12 + this iter added more handlers — splitting is overdue (>700 LoC rule). Specifically each tab body (TenantDebtsTab, SubscribersTab, AgentsTab, etc.) should be its own file with co-located state.

EntityCode.js:13-17 — shortCode slices the first 6 hex chars after stripping dashes. With 8 tenants today collisions are unlikely, but at scale (MAX_TENANTS=500) the birthday-paradox collision probability over 6 hex chars (16M space) is small but nonzero — if collisions matter for human reference, consider 8 chars or a checksum suffix.

MonitoringDashboard.js:39-47 — Polling interval has no jitter and uses raw setInterval. If many super-admin tabs are open, all hit /api/saas/stats on the same 30s tick. Acceptable for a single-admin internal tool but worth noting.

rca of the issue: Tenant Debts table missing EntityCode badges — most likely a simple omission in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/SaasAdminPage.js around line 1850+ (the tenant-debts table row render). The reusable EntityCode component already exists and works in Subscribers (line ~1075) and Agents (AgentsDashboard.js line 530+); spec explicitly mentions tenant-debts as the third location. Reproduction: login as admin → /saas-admin/tenant-debts → no column 'المعرّف' present in row cells. Mitigation: add `<EntityCode uuid={row.tenant_id} type='tenant' testId={`tenant-code-${row.tenant_id}`} />` to the first or near-first <td> of each tenant-debts row mirroring SubscribersTab.
